task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

runtime_boundary.event_plane: DOM CustomEvent on the main document with local async continuations

evidence: The DevTools-visible corpus is a single hard-style bundle without an exposed source map.
The target field name is assembled from character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search is incomplete.
The target value is carried through a reducer factory, selected slot, dynamic payload field, localStorage record and console wrapper.
The persist route selects its live profile after assignment material collection, tuple shape and state-machine outputs are available.

The click path crosses assignment material collection, intent routing, lane matrix routing, tuple construction, deferred scheduling, local state-plane dispatch, runtime config materialization, state encoding and sink wrapping.
The bundle contains shadow assignment outputs in debug/info, dataset and window cache locations that do not feed the target console.log assignment_code.
Vendor-like files and alternate reducer rows are imported into the same bundle and resemble target-producing code.
The target assignment code is separated from the click by Promise, microtask, timer, animation-frame and MutationObserver boundaries.
The selected reducer slot and runtime ticket are computed before the anchor receives the assignment envelope, route and machine state.
The final sink receives an already encoded value under a dynamically assembled field name and mirrors it into localStorage.

challenge_analysis.construct_validity_note: Primary bottleneck is semantic disambiguation among similarly named path functions in a large bundle; keyword search narrows high-score candidates but does not replace tracing the flag.persist path.

behavior_category.subtype: assignment envelope (flag, variant reference, version, scope) folded into a 12-char base36 persistence code
behavior_category.reason: The observable assignment_code is a compact deterministic encoding of the assignment envelope tuple, rollout scope and runtime config state: the receiver can decode and verify the stored code against the assignment state. It is not a request signature, byte-array payload, browser fingerprint or request-body rewrite, and no network request is emitted.

near_categories.why_not: The code is an encoding of assignment state, not an irreversible derivation: a receiver holding the envelope spec can decode and verify the persisted code, which a bucketing hash or digest would not allow.
No network request is emitted or rewritten; the localStorage record under ff_state and the console object only mirror the same locally persisted encoding.
The target is a 12-character base36 string code, not a byte buffer or binary payload transform.
